title: PsyCLIENT: Client Simulation via Conversational Trajectory Modeling for Trainee Practice and Model Evaluation in Mental Health Counseling
abstract: arXiv:2601.07312v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based client simulation provides a scalable approach to novice counselor training, counseling-dialogue synthesis, and interactive evaluation of automated counseling systems. However, existing approaches are limited by insufficient profile diversity, weak behavioral grounding, and the lack of open Chinese-language resources for simulated counseling clients. We propose PsyCLIENT, a framework that conditions simulated-client responses on client profiles, dialogue histories, and conversational trajectories specifying target behaviors and content constraints at each client turn. translated_title: PsyCLIENT：基于对话轨迹建模的来访者模拟，用于心理健康咨询中的受训者练习与模型评估
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的来访者模拟为新手咨询师培训、咨询对话合成以及自动化咨询系统的交互式评估提供了一种可扩展的途径。然而，现有方法存在以下局限：来访者画像多样性不足、行为依据薄弱，且缺乏面向模拟咨询来访者的开放中文资源。我们提出了PsyCLIENT，该框架基于来访者画像、对话历史以及为每一轮来访者回应指定目标行为与内容约束的对话轨迹来生成模拟来访者的回应。我们还构建了PsyCLIENT-CP数据集，其中包含涵盖60个咨询主题的120个中文来访者画像。由24名专业咨询师参与的评估表明，与对比方法相比，PsyCLIENT在感知真实性和培训实用性方面获得了更高的评分。在另一项来源识别研究中，PsyCLIENT生成的对话更频繁地被误判为真人对话。
tldr: PsyCLIENT通过对话轨迹建模来驱动心理咨询来访者模拟，并配套构建了包含120个中文来访者画像的PsyCLIENT-CP数据集，经24名专业咨询师验证，其在真实性和培训实用性上优于现有方法，为新手咨询师训练与心理咨询系统评估提供了可扩展的新方案。
en_tdlr: PsyCLIENT simulates mental health counseling clients through conversational trajectory modeling and introduces the PsyCLIENT-CP dataset of 120 Chinese client profiles, achieving higher authenticity and training utility than existing methods, thus enabling scalable trainee practice and evaluation of counseling systems.
